task: R30 v1.1 merged protocol (VCS_R30_v1_1_Merged_Server_20261101): 7 parent states (H: f00_s1001, f60_s1001/1002/1003; L: f60_s1001/1002/1003), 30 unique paths = 12 FULL40 (old H0/L0/Ls/PN/PV/PB x 0%/60% x s1001, unit ids kept) + 13 SHORT10 crossover branches + 5 CONTROL10 (reuse audit -> all RUN).
migration: Pre-submission migration: no formal R30 GPU job had been submitted (only CPU checks 1080020/1080044 and the runfill v1 smoke+gate 1080050, pre-migration evidence). v1 snapshot code_r30/ (frozen, used by 1080050) is kept unchanged; v1.1 snapshot code_r30v11/ = code_r30 + changes in r30_align/r30_co_train/r30_run/r30_calibrate + new r30_state.py (R30_V11_DIFF.patch = migration diff; R30_V11_DIFF_VS_R29.patch = all new files vs code_r29; the 29 code_r29 files are byte-identical). v1 entry points retired: LINES_R30_OLD_SUPERSEDED.txt (every line commented out), sbatch/v1_SUPERSEDED/*.superseded, PROTOCOL_FROZEN_v1_SUPERSEDED.json, DEVIATIONS_v1_SUPERSEDED.json, tools/*_v1_SUPERSEDED.py. The v1 runner also cannot resolve v1.1 unit ids.
boundary_mechanism: R25/R27 --prefix_epoch saves the complete state only at the end of a co-train epoch, so it is not a warmup boundary. R30 adds one save point: r30_co_train.warmup_main = r25_co_train.main up to the end of its warmup loop (line-for-line, CPU-checked), then the unchanged save_full_state with epoch -1 -> parent_state.pt (chmod 444) + PARENT.json (sha256, training-state fingerprint, data split / noise / env / code digests). Boundary = after the 5th warmup epoch of both peers and its full-DEV validation, before the first co-train adjust_learning_rate / eval_train / loader / sampling. Refiners, queues and queue IDs are first created (consuming RNG) by train() at co-train epoch 0 in the native order; LR schedule = stateless adjust_learning_rate(co-train epoch), which restarts at epoch 0 from the boundary (lr_update 15 unchanged, also for 10-epoch branches). The resume branch of r25_co_train.main starts at epoch -1 + 1 = 0.
warmup_sources: H = R29 h_native warmup (native VSE.train(mode=warmup)); L = R29 l_listwise_vcs warmup (R29 listwise-VCS warmup recipe, 0.5 x (mean i2t + mean t2i)). Both via R29.install() + R29 warmup_step with report-only diagnostics; H and L of a cell start from the same seed-determined untrained init.
fork_resume: Entry r30_run.py separates --r30_source_warmup, --r30_objective + --r30_scale (continuation objective), --r30_mode fork|resume. fork: only the registered parent (sha256, parent id, source, epoch -1 boundary, identical scientific opt keys STRICT_KEYS incl. max_iters i.e. smoke vs formal) -> load -> FORK_REPORT.json: parent-file vs live loaded state fingerprint compared component by component (both encoders, both AdamW states incl. step/moments/param groups, counters, RNG, epoch, best_rsum, all_loss); allowed opt differences = data_path/output_dir/resume/num_epochs/log_step/prefix flags/r29_arm/r27_epoch + r30_* metadata; anything else refuses. resume: only this unit's own state (unit id, parent sha + fingerprint, source, objective, scale, coefficient, budget, milestone, STRICT_KEYS) and only if the budget is not completed; a parent can never be resumed and a branch state can never be forked. The v1 cross-arm protection is kept in this stricter form, not removed.
epoch_numbering: raw_epoch = r25_co_train.main co-train epoch index (0-based); completed_cotrain_epochs = raw_epoch + 1; written into every history entry together with updates_epoch / updates_cumulative (= optimizer steps of both peers, stats 'steps') and METRICS.jsonl (templates/METRICS_SCHEMA.json fields; boundary row completed 0 / raw null / updates 0 from the parent's last warmup DEV). Milestone (completed 10 = raw 9): state_last.pt is hard-linked to state_completed10.pt (chmod 444; never overwritten; the runner refuses a checkpoint without its record), E10_RECORD.json (same-checkpoint six recalls, checkpoint sha) and RANKS_completed10.npz (per-query i2t/t2i ranks of the peer-averaged score from an extra eval pass after the save; recomputed recalls must equal the native validate; RNG verified unchanged). FULL40 units continue to 40; SHORT10/CONTROL10 units have num_epochs 10 (native LR schedule; no compression). The R29-style keep_states (raw epoch 10/20) is not used in v1.1 (it would mislabel completed epochs).
objectives: H native hinge (diagonal-only); L = R29 listwise VCS, N = R29 K=128 multi-positive InfoNCE (not PN), B = R29 listwise BCE (not PB), all coefficient 1 and the R29 co-train reduction (sum rows i2t + sum rows t2i, observed-ID multi-positive); Ls = L x c, PN/PV/PB = hard comparison x c (formulas unchanged from v1; CPU and GPU checked vs the package reference).
calibration: unchanged from v1 except the parent binding: matching H parent of s1001 (wp_f00_s1001_H_e5, wp_f60_s1001_H_e5); first 64 labeled FIT minibatches of size >= 2 PER PEER of the epoch-0 loaders after the native prelude (both peers pooled = 128 gradient pairs); one train-mode forward per batch shared by all terms; torch.autograd.grad of the main term only; no DEV loaded; eval_train truth argument None; separate process on the read-only parent (file sha256 + fingerprint verified unchanged after); zero / non-finite -> TECHNICAL_ANOMALY, no coefficient.
pairwise_and_ties: row = uniform mean over observed-ID positives, each vs the same hardest non-positive (detached argmax, first maximal index on ties, ties counted); rows without a negative contribute 0 and are counted; reduction = sum over rows of both directions.
positives_reference_difference: Non-native objectives use the R29 observed-ID multi-positive rule; H keeps native diagonal-only (an in-batch caption of the same observed image is a negative for H).
hardware_blocks: main-session decision: a block = one (noise, seed) cell incl. its parents, calibration and all children, on one GPU type: f00_s1001 and f60_s1001 -> RTX6000PRO; f60_s1002 and f60_s1003 -> L40S; always --exclude=node51,node53,node60, normal QOS, nice 0, no --dependency, self-continuation <= 3 attempts. The driver refuses any device other than CELLS_R30.json block_gpu. Smoke/gate jobs on runfill.
controls: all 5 CONTROL10 -> RUN10_CONTROL (REUSE_DECISIONS.json): R29 ran with --prefix_epoch -1 (no boundary / fingerprint), its state_epoch10.pt is raw epoch 10 = 11 completed epochs (no completed-10 checkpoint), no replay equivalence can be shown; f60_s1002/1003 R29 ran on RTX PRO 6000 while the R30 blocks are L40S. R29 EPOCHS stay auxiliary historical trajectories.
queue_order: LINES_R30.txt order is queue order only: stage-view FULL40 H0/L0 (4), the 18 10-epoch branches/controls, then the FULL40 Ls/PN/PV/PB (8, need the calibrations). Parents and calibrations are submitted by this agent after the gate; no result-based gating.
